items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Was it still called Billy Berg's Swing Club? ... I would like to recall this incident that happened while we were at Billy Berg's Swing Club.

ctx.x: Was it called the Swing Club? [Was it] still called Billy Berg's Swing Club?
. . . and it had Milt Jackson, the drummer Stan Levy . . .
